query_sql: SELECT value FROM system.settings WHERE name='max_memory_usage'
description_zh: 单查询最大内存使用不应为 0（0 表示不限制，需配合 max_server_memory_usage 防 OOM）；建议显式设置上限
description_en: Per-query max memory should not be 0 (0 = unlimited); set an explicit limit with max_server_memory_usage

query_sql: SELECT value FROM system.settings WHERE name='max_memory_usage_for_all_queries'
description_zh: 全局查询最大内存使用不应为 0（0 表示不限制），建议设为物理内存的 80% 左右防 OOM（26.7 用 max_memory_usage_for_all_queries）
description_en: Global max memory usage for all queries should not be 0; set to ~80% of RAM

description_zh: 最大并发查询数(全局)应 >= 100，过小会限制并发吞吐（26.7 已拆分为 _for_all_users/_for_user）

query_sql: SELECT value FROM system.settings WHERE name='background_pool_size'
description_zh: 后台合并线程池大小应 >= 8，过小会导致合并积压、part 数量膨胀
description_en: Background pool size should be >= 8 to avoid merge backlog

query_sql: SELECT value FROM system.settings WHERE name='max_execution_time'
description_zh: 单查询最大执行时间应大于 0（秒），防止失控查询长期占用资源
description_en: Max execution time should be > 0 to prevent runaway queries

query_sql: SELECT value FROM system.settings WHERE name='max_rows_to_read'
description_zh: 单查询最大读取行数应大于 0，防止全表扫描耗尽 IO
description_en: Max rows to read should be > 0

query_sql: SELECT value FROM system.settings WHERE name='max_insert_block_size'
description_zh: 单次插入块大小应 >= 1048576（默认），过小会降低写入吞吐
description_en: Max insert block size should be >= 1048576

query_sql: SELECT value FROM system.settings WHERE name='max_partitions_per_insert_block'
description_zh: 单次插入最大分区数应大于 0，防止一次写入过多分区导致内存飙升
description_en: Max partitions per insert block should be > 0

description_zh: 后台合并/突变并发比应大于 0，控制合并对前台查询的影响
description_en: Background merges/mutations concurrency ratio should be > 0
